basic_info.description: Nestled just steps from Mountain Lake Park and the picturesque Lake Street corridor, this character-rich duplex offers a rare opportunity in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods. Enjoy unbeatable walkability to Clement Street's vibrant commercial scene, with easy access to top-tier restaurants, groceries, cafes, nightlife, and public transit.    Brimming with original charm and architectural details true to its period, this property showcases a level of craftsmanship and character that's increasingly hard to find. Ideal for both investors and owner-occupants, the lower unit features 2 bedrooms and 1 bath, offering plenty of potential for thoughtful updates. The expansive upper unit boasts 4 bedrooms and 2 baths, including a generous primary suite complete with a soaking tub.    The shared outdoor yard space is a blank canvas, perfect for a gardening enthusiast or for creating your own private outdoor oasis.    Whether you're looking to live in one unit and collect market-rate rental income from the other, or fully invest in a high-demand area, this timeless duplex delivers on location, potential, and charm.    Don't miss this unique opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco history in the heart of Inner Richmond.
